summary: Completed Module 06 Step 3 BUILD: implemented Cache-Aside with Redis, cache eviction on link mutations, Redis down graceful fallback, and org-scoped key isolation.
evidence: Built CacheService in apps/api/src/services/cache.service.ts with ioredis client, TTL + jitter, and fault-tolerant circuit breaker.
Wired resolveRedirect for Cache-Aside: confirmed first redirect returns X-Cache: MISS and populates cache; second redirect returns X-Cache: HIT in sub-millisecond latency (0.91ms).
Implemented PATCH and DELETE endpoints with immediate cache eviction, confirming zero stale redirects after mutations.
Executed Redis down drill: simulated hard Redis outage and proved redirects fall back to PostgreSQL with zero 500 errors.
Implemented org_scoping twist with tenant:{tenantId}:link:{id} key namespacing, verifying cross-tenant cache isolation.
